'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[2025 Gaza European Hospital strikes]]
***At least 28 people are killed in an Israeli air strike that struck the [[Gaza European Hospital]], which the Israeli military claims had a Hamas command and control centre beneath the building. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2jvx3yjg3o (BBC News)]
*[[Puntland counter-terrorism operations]]
**Three [[Al-Shabaab (militant group)|Al-Shabaab]] fighters, including a senior commander, are killed in a coordinated operation by the [[Somali National Army]] in [[Jowle]], [[Mudug]], [[Puntland]]. [https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/senior-al-shabaab-commander-killed-in-somalia (Garowe Online)]

*[[Microsoft Inc.]] abruptly [[layoff|lays off]] 6,000 people, 3% of its global workforce, citing [[workforce productivity]]. '''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Russian wildfires]]
**A [[state of emergency]] is declared in [[Buryatia]], [[Far Eastern Federal District]], [[Russia]], as [[firefighter]]s fight [[wildfire]]s currently burning more than 53,000 hectares. [https://www.themoscowtimes.com/2025/05/13/siberias-buryatia-declares-wildfire-emergency-a89059 (''The Moscow Times'')]

*Nine people are killed after a truck carrying stones collided with a [[Federal Reserve Unit]] truck in [[Teluk Intan]], [[Malaysia]]. [https://www.theborneopost.com/2025/05/13/fru-truck-crash-sand-lorry-driver-driver-detained-tested-negative-for-drugs/ (Borneo Post Online)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Syria–United States relations]]
**[[President of the United States|US President]] [[Donald Trump]] announces that the [[United States]] will lift all [[International sanctions against Syria|sanctions imposed on Syria]] under the [[Ba'athist Syria|previous regime]] of [[President of Syria|President]] [[Bashar al-Assad]], and expresses willingness to work with the [[Syrian transitional government]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/liveblog/2025/5/13/live-us-president-donald-trump-embarks-on-historic-middle-east-trip (Al Jazeera)]

**[[Brazil]]ian [[Military Police (Brazil)|Military Police]] kill the main leader of the [[Terceiro Comando Puro]], a [[drug trafficking]] [[organized crime|criminal organization]], and two other suspected members, in a [[shootout]] in the [[Maré, Rio de Janeiro|Maré]] [[favela]] in [[Rio de Janeiro]]. '''Politics and elections'''
*[[Islamic State insurgency in Puntland]]
**[[Puntland counter-terrorism operations]]
***A spokesperson for the [[Puntland Security Force]] confirms that [[Puntland]] has acquired four [[military helicopter]]s to support ongoing military operations against [[Islamic State]] militants in the region. [https://www.garoweonline.com/en/news/somalia/puntland-acquires-combat-helicopters-for-anti-isis-operations-in-mountains (Garowe Online)]
*[[2025 Liberal Party of Australia leadership election]]
**[[Sussan Ley]] is elected as the new leader of the [[Liberal Party of Australia]] following the party's defeat at [[2025 Australian federal election|Saturday's federal election]]. Ley is the first woman to hold the post. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/australias-albanese-labor-government-sworn-second-term-2025-05-13/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 Malian protests]], [[2020 Malian coup d'état]]
**[[Mali]]an interim [[List of heads of state of Mali|president]] [[Assimi Goïta]] signs a decree dissolving all [[List of political parties in Mali|political parties]] and organizations and bans them from holding meetings following ongoing pro-[[democracy]] protests in the capital city [[Bamako]]. [https://apnews.com/article/mali-political-parties-dissolve-military-b9a97cc673cc11a804e023250fbecaea (AP)] [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2025/5/13/mali-dissolves-all-political-parties-after-opposition-figures-arrested (Al Jazeera)]
*[[Prime Minister of Peru]] [[Gustavo Adrianzén]] resigns a day before a [[vote of censure]] against him over rising crime in [[Peru]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/peru-swaps-out-economy-minister-2025-05-13/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[Major League Baseball]]
**[[Commissioner of Baseball]] [[Rob Manfred]] announces that all deceased individuals on the [[List of people banned from Major League Baseball|permanent ineligible list]] will be reinstated, allowing players like [[Pete Rose]] and [[Shoeless Joe Jackson]] to be elected into the [[National Baseball Hall of Fame and Museum]]. [https://www.espn.com/mlb/story/_/id/45115659/pete-rose-shoeless-joe-jackson-players-reinstated-mlb (ESPN)]
